title: SMS from a US local number fails with error 30034 until A2P 10DLC registration is approved
symptoms: 30034 US A2P 10DLC - Message from an Unregistered Number
Message status undelivered while messaging fees are still charged
Sends fail while the Brand or Campaign is still under review
cause: Since 2023-09-01 Twilio blocks all US bound SMS and MMS from +1 10DLC numbers that are not in the sender pool of a Messaging Service tied to an approved A2P Campaign.
fix: Finish Brand and Campaign registration, add the number to the Messaging Service linked to the Campaign, and send through that service. Use a toll-free number, short code or Verify while registration is pending.
apply: await client.messages.create({ messagingServiceSid: process.env.TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID, to: '+15551234567', body: 'Your order shipped' });
affected: US bound messages from +1 10DLC numbers, fully blocked since 2023-09-01
